parcels.locker/authored/adv-absent-flag.purpose: The input guard beside a subject guard reads an absent Optional input as Unknown, so the guarded refusal is not taken.

parcels.locker/authored/adv-absent-stamp.purpose: The input guard beside a held-state guard reads an absent Optional input as Unknown, so the default answers.

parcels.locker/authored/adv-taken-closed.purpose: A taken code on a closed locker for a vip is answered by existing_instance, before the related row whose branches would leave the step open.

parcels.locker/authored/adv-two-acceptin.purpose: On an open locker two accepting when-branches of RushParcel hold for a vip; ESS's synthesis selects neither, so the step is left open.

parcels.locker/authored/deposit-and-coll.purpose: A courier deposits two parcels, notes one, discards the other, and the recipient collects the first without a signature.

parcels.locker/authored/left-open.purpose: An accepting express guard that holds on a closed locker overlaps the closed-locker refusal; the model leaves the answer open, so an implementation may give either.

parcels.locker/authored/minted-code.purpose: Parcels registered without a code are created under distinct codes the system mints, and a minted code skips one a caller already supplied.

parcels.locker/authored/precedence.purpose: Input-guarded refusals answer before a related row and before an accepting guard, and a code the caller may supply is refused when sent twice.

parcels.locker/authored/refusals.purpose: A taken code, a missing locker, a closed locker, an empty note, a refused signature and an unknown parcel are each refused.

parcels.locker/authored/related-input.purpose: A closed-locker refusal guarded on the input as well is taken only when that input guard holds, so a staff parcel and any other parcel are refused differently.

parcels.locker/authored/subject-input.purpose: Subject and held-state guards take their branch only when the input guard beside them holds.

parcels.locker/authored/two-related.purpose: Two closed-locker refusals hold on the same locker; the model leaves the answer open, so an implementation may give either.
